title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Academy destinations where cadets study, train, gather, or take part in the shared campus program.

cards.title: Library at Waesche Hall
cards.subtitle: Waesche Hall
cards.notes: Bring a research task, a map-heavy assignment, or a group project; the library identifies quiet study, large tables, and collaborative spaces.
cards.short_summary: A flexible academic workspace with quiet and collaborative options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy Library in Waesche Hall provides large tables, collaborative spaces for group projects, and quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Library — United States Coast Guard Academy
cards.access_notes: Library services are for cadets, faculty, and staff; verify visitor access with the Academy before arrival.

cards.title: Hewitt Writing and Reading Center
cards.subtitle: Second deck of the Library, Waesche Hall
cards.notes: Schedule a session or upload work through the center’s scheduling program when you want feedback from mentors, tutors, writers, or educators.
cards.short_summary: Writing and reading support located inside the Academy Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hewitt Writing and Reading Center is on the second deck of the Library in Waesche Hall and provides mentoring and tutoring to cadets in every class year and major.
cards.source_title: Cadet Life and Resources — United States Coast Guard Academy Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog says cadets can make appointments through the online scheduling program.

cards.title: Chase Hall
cards.subtitle: Cadet barracks and All Hands Dining Facility
cards.notes: Use the building as a landmark for core cadet life: the campus map identifies both cadet barracks and the All Hands Dining Facility here.
cards.short_summary: A central cadet-life building that combines housing and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy campus map lists Chase Hall as the location of the All Hands Dining Facility, cadet barracks, and Cadet Store.
cards.source_title: United States Coast Guard Academy Campus Map
cards.access_notes: On-campus dining is available to faculty, staff, cadets with some limitations, and visitors; Academy security rules apply.

cards.title: Leamy Hall
cards.subtitle: Auditorium, bowling alley, cafés, and Coast Guard Band
cards.notes: Check the Academy calendar for a band concert or event, and use the map-listed cafés and bowling alley as on-campus gathering points.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use campus building with performance, recreation, and café spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy campus map identifies Leamy Hall as containing an auditorium, bowling alley, cafés, MWR office, chaplains, and the U.S. Coast Guard Band.
cards.source_title: United States Coast Guard Academy Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Public attendance at Coast Guard Band concerts is subject to the Academy’s security posture.

cards.title: Roland Hall Gym
cards.subtitle: Athletics facilities
cards.notes: Look for Academy athletics programming around this map-listed gym; physical development and sports are part of the cadet program.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gym within the Academy’s broad athletics program.
cards.evidence_claim: Roland Hall Gym is identified on the Academy campus map, and the Academy states that every cadet competes through varsity, club, or intramural sports.
cards.source_title: Athletics — United States Coast Guard Academy
cards.access_notes: Use the Academy campus map to locate Roland Hall Gym; access may be limited by Academy operations.

cards.title: Cadet Memorial Field
cards.subtitle: Athletics field
cards.notes: Watch for an Academy athletic event or use the field as a clear campus waypoint; varsity, club, and intramural participation involves every cadet.
cards.short_summary: A named Academy athletics field tied to the cadet sports program.
cards.evidence_claim: Cadet Memorial Field is identified on the Academy campus map, and the Academy says every cadet participates in varsity, club, or intramural sports.
cards.source_title: Athletics — United States Coast Guard Academy
cards.access_notes: Event and spectator access depend on the Academy schedule and security posture.

cards.title: Sailing Center
cards.subtitle: Academy waterfront
cards.notes: Spot the waterfront training infrastructure from an approved campus route and consult Academy programming before expecting access to boats or instruction.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed waterfront destination supporting the Academy’s maritime setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy campus map identifies a Sailing Center and Sail Loft on the waterfront side of campus.
cards.source_title: United States Coast Guard Academy Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Waterfront facilities may be operational or restricted; remain on permitted visitor routes.

cards.title: Rowing Center
cards.subtitle: Academy waterfront
cards.notes: Use this named waterfront destination to orient a campus walk, then check the athletics schedule for any public-facing rowing activity.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed rowing facility on the Academy waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy campus map identifies the Rowing Center as a named campus destination.
cards.source_title: United States Coast Guard Academy Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Access to training areas and waterfront operations may be restricted.

cards.title: Barque Eagle
cards.subtitle: Academy waterfront
cards.notes: When the vessel is in port and viewable from an approved route, use it as a tangible link to cadet sail training and Academy maritime history.
cards.short_summary: The Coast Guard’s tall ship and a cadet training vessel.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy identifies the 295-foot Barque EAGLE as the Coast Guard flagship and a training vessel for Coast Guard Academy cadets.
cards.source_title: Tenants — United States Coast Guard Academy
cards.access_notes: The vessel’s presence and boarding access vary with its operational schedule; do not expect public access without confirmation.

cards.title: Bear Plaza
cards.subtitle: Campus mascot memorial
cards.notes: Pause at the plaza’s Objee statue and connect it to a documented piece of Academy identity before heading to an athletic event or pep rally.
cards.short_summary: The campus location that memorializes the Academy’s bear mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy history page states that Objee is memorialized by a statue in Bear Plaza and that the mascot appears at pep rallies and athletic events.
cards.source_title: History — United States Coast Guard Academy
cards.access_notes: Follow Academy visitor and security requirements while on campus.
